title: LightAC
description: This project adds sub-tick combat validation to prevent 0-tick shield breaking and aura exploits on 1.21.11 servers.
body:
# LightAC - The Lightweight Combat Guardian

LightAC is a modern anticheat built for performance and accuracy. Designed specifically for competitive PvP servers on version 1.21.11, it focuses on detecting complex combat exploits without ruining the player experience.

### Key Features:
* **0-Tick Detection:** Advanced checks for instant weapon/attribute swapping (Shield-breaking exploits).
* **Zero Hit-Delay:** Optimized packet processing to ensure combat feels smooth.
* **Smart Combat Checks:** Robust detection for Reach and KillAura with sub-tick accuracy.
* **Fast Fly Detection:** Responsive movement checks that catch cheaters much faster than vanilla.
* **Low Server Impact:** Lightweight code designed for high-player counts.

*Note: Optimized for standard gameplay; extreme ping (1000ms+) may trigger safety setbacks.*
